0022600137.text: The Bulls (1-3, 11th in the East) host the Knicks (1-3, 12th in the East) on a two-game losing streak for Chicago, while New York has won its last game. Chicago is missing Nic Claxton (hamstring), Patrick Williams (groin soreness), and Tobe Awaka (ankle), and New York is without Jose Alvarado (ankle sprain). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and in 2025-26 the Bulls lost the series 1-3, including a 136-96 loss in New York on April 3, 2026.
